title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10462__PART_1_)
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the fictitious calculation method of determination of dimensions of protective coverings of paper insulated cables [ see Taper insulated lead-sheathed cables for electricity supply ( second revision )' ].

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
